_route.brief: The reference shop on challenge: the Appraisal Board's fees pay the rent while a small wine cellar, one furnace and the vending machine earn on the side. The deed costs 36,000 and climbs faster than any savings, so the shop is never insured (challenge triples the fee), buys Wild's upgrades with favor alone, lends Georgio the most it can on day 43 and signs the loan shark's mortgage around day 70. Sixteen payments later the shop is ours.
